subject: general
question: Captain Roop Singh Stadium is located in which of the following city?
solution:
The correct answer is __Gwalior__.

__
 
• Captain Roop Singh Stadium is a cricket stadium in the Gwalior district of Madhya Pradesh.
 
• It was established in 1978.
 
• The first ODI on this ground was played in 1988.
